description: Eclipse Meridian — governed telehealth operations — jurisdiction-gated encounters, signed-note integrity, PHI access evidence. Not a healthcare provider. Meridian Core (19 MCP tools) fuses three locks: (A) encounters execute only when licensure x consent set x mandate verify AT ENCOUNTER TIME against the patient's per-encounter attested location — license re-verified per encounter, never cached; a location change booking->start re-runs the full gate (JURISDICTION_MISMATCH / CONSENT_SET_INCOMPLETE); jurisdiction rules are versioned counsel-signed DATA packs, never code constants. (B) Note-integrity pin: AI drafts live cryptographically OUTSIDE the record (UNSIGNED_DRAFT_NOT_RECORD) until the treating clinician signs the exact canonical fingerprint; post-signature change is a new version + addendum, never a silent edit. PRODUCT LAW: no note_finalize-class tool exists in the surface — signature is the clinician's act, never an agent capability. (C) Minimum-necessary PHI reads: purpose-declared, mandate-scoped field-class projection enforced server-side; every read granted or refused seals a 164.312(b)-shaped hash-chained access record, practice-held and offline-verifiable. Meridian Bridge (HAPI FHIR sandbox adapter in P0) REFUSES live PHI without an executed BAA + complete flow-down inventory (BAA_REQUIRED, no break-glass). Part 2 + minor-restricted classes default EXCLUDED from every mandate; recording requires affirmative consent from every participant; no prescribing surface in any phase. P0 synthetic-only (Synthea-shaped fixtures).
